answer: Each new agent locks a 5,000-token bond for three epochs before its votes count, and peers check that every bond comes from a distinct funded history, not a fresh split. Faking 100 agents means freezing 500,000 tokens with no payout, so the sybil garden costs more than it can ever harvest; renting keys fails because the bond stays tied to the renter's own address. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back, so the network stays an oasis where one real voice is the pearl worth funding.
